Atkin page 2 finishes the acknowledgements, states the intended readership, and begins section 2, Ramanujan Congruences for primes q≤11. It reports the original partition congruence as (2.1), defines x, f(x) and eta(tau), and gives the partition generating function (2.2). The C of Congruences is slashed with a matching left-margin mark. A comma instruction attaches to theory. The typed we have is cancelled beside the eta definition and re-entered by hand beside the sum; as his proofs is cancelled above the footnote and repeated live below it. Dates present: RAMANUJAN(1919), DYSON(1944), ATKIN and SWINNERTON-DYER(1954).

S042-PARTITIONS: Expanding each factor (1−x^k)^(−1) as a geometric series chooses the multiplicity of part k. Thus the coefficient of x^n in their product counts unordered partitions and yields the displayed 1/f(x), under the usual positive-part convention. S042-ETA-FACTOR: With x=e^(2πiτ), the displayed exponential e^(πiτ/12) equals x^(1/24) on that parametrization; this checks the factor stated in the next paragraph. These limited checks do not prove the modular transformation claim or the congruence (2.1). The latter is explicitly presented as a conjecture, and the page breaks mid-discussion.
